description: Exact formulas of the Revision field theory (SPEC sections 1-4, 6) for the author's primordial metric, for the documents. Every formula is verified by a named check of Revision/theory/reports/wolfram-field-theory.json. Wolfram InputForm; g[xa] = gamma^(xa) of Revision/algebra/gammas.json; a4' = Derivative[1][a4][x4]; z = 6 H x8; Psibar = Psi^dagger C; S = Psibar Psi; V = m + U'(S); both statistics unless stated.

formulas.description: nonzero Christoffel symbols {l, m, n, Gamma^l_mn} (m <= n; Gamma^l_nm = Gamma^l_mn), indices 1..8 = x1..x8
R^mu_mu (no sum), mu = x1..x8; all off-diagonal R^mu_nu vanish
formulas.wl: {-6*H^2 + Derivative[2][a4][x4], -6*H^2 + Derivative[2][a4][x4], -6*H^2 + Derivative[2][a4][x4], 6*Derivative[1][a4][x4]^2, -6*H^2 - Derivative[2][a4][x4], -6*H^2 - Derivative[2][a4][x4], -6*H^2 - Derivative[2][a4][x4], -6*H^2}

formulas.description: Ricci scalar R
nonzero omega_mu,ab = eta_ac omega_mu^c_b as {mu, a, b, value} with a < b (omega_mu,ba = -omega_mu,ab); frame indices a, b = 1..8 aligned with x1..x8
the spinor connection Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu,ab S^ab
formulas.wl: Omega_xi = (1/2) E^a4[x4] Sin[6 H x8]^(1/6) (a4'[x4] g[xi].g[x4] + H g[xi].g[x8]) (i = 1, 2, 3); Omega_xt = -(1/2) E^-a4[x4] Sin[6 H x8]^(1/6) (a4'[x4] g[x4].g[xt] + H g[xt].g[x8]) (t = 5, 6, 7); Omega_x4 = Omega_x8 = 0; g[xa] = gamma^(xa) (frame gammas of the fixture)

formulas.description: the matrices gamma^mu Omega_mu (no sum) for mu = x1..x8 as coefficients of gamma^(x4) and gamma^(x8): {mu, coefficient of gamma^(x4), coefficient of gamma^(x8)}
gamma^mu Omega_mu (sum over mu); g[x8] = gamma^(x8)
formulas.wl: 3*H*gamma["x8"]

formulas.description: Lagrangian density for both statistics (SPEC section 3), Psibar = Psi^dagger C, S = Psibar Psi, sqrt g = Cos[z]
formulas.wl: L = Cos[z] [ (1/2) sum_mu (Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U(S) ] = Cos[z] [ (1/2) sum_a (1/f_a) (Psibar gamma^(a) d_a Psi - d_a Psibar gamma^(a) Psi) - m S - U(S) ]; f_(1,2,3) = E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), f_4 = 1, f_(5,6,7) = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), f_8 = Cot[z]

formulas.description: the Euler-Lagrange equation (both statistics), z = 6 H x8, V = m + U'(S)
formulas.wl: E^-a4[x4] Sin[z]^(-1/6) (g[x1] d1 + g[x2] d2 + g[x3] d3) Psi + g[x4] d4 Psi + E^a4[x4] Sin[z]^(-1/6) (g[x5] d5 + g[x6] d6 + g[x7] d7) Psi + Tan[z] g[x8] d8 Psi + 3 H g[x8] Psi = (m + U'(S)) Psi

formulas.description: the adjoint equation (both statistics); for this metric D_mu Psibar = d_mu Psibar - Psibar Omega_mu
formulas.wl: E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (d1 Psibar g[x1] + d2 Psibar g[x2] + d3 Psibar g[x3]) + d4 Psibar g[x4] + E^a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (d5 Psibar g[x5] + d6 Psibar g[x6] + d7 Psibar g[x7]) + Tan[z] d8 Psibar g[x8] + 3 H Psibar g[x8] = -(m + U'(S)) Psibar

formulas.description: the 16 component equations (gamma^mu D_mu Psi)_A = V Psi_A, A = 1..16 (rows of the fixture gammas), V = m + U'(S); dd[xa, Psi[B]] = d Psi_B / d xa

block form: Psi = (psi_minus (rows 1..8, Gamma = -1), psi_plus (rows 9..16, Gamma = +1)); gamma^(xa) = {{0, tb[xa]}, {t[xa], 0}}; equations sum_a (1/f_a) tb[xa] d_a psi_plus + 3 H tb[x8] psi_plus = V psi_minus and sum_a (1/f_a) t[xa] d_a psi_minus + 3 H t[x8] psi_minus = V psi_plus; listed {xa, tb, t}
conserved current and its identity (both statistics)
formulas.wl: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi; d_mu (Cos[z] J^mu) = -i Cos[z] (Ebar Psi + Psibar E); J^x4 = Psi^dagger B Psi; Q = Integral Cos[z] Psi^dagger B Psi dx1 dx2 dx3 dx5 dx6 dx7 dx8

formulas.description: second-order identity (both statistics)
formulas.wl: (gamma^mu D_mu)^2 Psi = g^mu,nu (D_mu D_nu - Gamma^l_mu,nu D_l) Psi - (R/4) Psi, R = 6 (a4'[x4]^2 - 7 H^2)

formulas.description: energy-momentum tensor from the vielbein variation (both statistics), T^nu_mu = e^b_mu (1/sqrt g) dS/de^b_nu, L0 = L/sqrt g
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/2) (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi) - (1/4) g_mu,rho nabla_l (Psibar {gamma^l, Sigma^(nu rho)} Psi), Sigma^(nu rho) = (1/4) [gamma^nu, gamma^rho]

formulas.description: symmetric (Belinfante) energy-momentum tensor = symmetric part of the variation tensor = the variation tensor on shell
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/4) (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi)

formulas.description: diagonal components (no sum), both statistics; K_mu = kinetic term of direction mu
formulas.wl: K_mu = (1/(2 f_mu)) (Psibar gamma^(mu) d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^(mu) Psi); L0 = sum_mu K_mu - m S - U(S); T^mu_mu = L0 - K_mu; rho = -T^x4_x4 = -sum_(mu != x4) K_mu + m S + U; p3 = T^x1_x1 (= T^x2_x2 = T^x3_x3 for isotropic states) = sum_(mu != x1) K_mu - m S - U; p_t = T^x5_x5 = sum_(mu != x5) K_mu - m S - U; p8 = T^x8_x8 = sum_(mu != x8) K_mu - m S - U

formulas.description: split into kinetic (derivative) and potential parts
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = T_kin^nu_mu + T_pot^nu_mu, T_pot^nu_mu = -delta^nu_mu (m S + U(S)), T_kin^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu sum_l K_l - (1/4)(Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi); potential energy density rho_pot = m S + U, potential pressure p_pot = -(m S + U) in every direction

formulas.description: trace
formulas.wl: T^mu_mu (sum) = 8 L0 - sum_mu K_mu = 7 sum_mu K_mu - 8 (m S + U); on shell = 7 (m + U') S - 8 (m S + U) = -m S + 7 S U' - 8 U

formulas.description: homogeneous states (Psi depends on x4 only): K_mu = 0 for mu != x4 and K_x4 = (m + U') S on shell
formulas.wl: rho = m S + U(S); p3 = p_t = p8 = S U'(S) - U(S); w = (S U' - U)/(m S + U); for U = (lam/2) S^2: rho = m S + lam S^2/2, p = lam S^2/2, w = lam S/(2 m + lam S)

formulas.description: the x4-x8 component of the symmetric tensor (Omega_x4 = Omega_x8 = 0)
formulas.wl: T^x4_x8 = -(1/4) (B48 - Cot[z] B84), B48 = Psibar gamma^(x4) d8 Psi - d8 Psibar gamma^(x4) Psi, B84 = Psibar gamma^(x8) d4 Psi - d4 Psibar gamma^(x8) Psi; T^x8_x4 = -Tan[z]^2 T^x4_x8 (T_x4x8 = T_x8x4)

formulas.description: conservation for a homogeneous diagonal T = diag(p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t, p8)(x4)
formulas.wl: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -rho'[x4] - 3 a4'[x4] (p3 - p_t) = 0, i.e. d rho/d x4 = -3 a4'[x4] (p3 - p_t)

formulas.description: canonical quantisation of dirac16complex (SPEC section 6), x4 the evolution time
formulas.wl: pi_A = (i/2) Cos[z] (Psi^dagger B)_A; K = Cos[z] C gamma^(x4) = i Cos[z] B; {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)}_(x4 = y4) = B_AC delta^7(x - y)/Cos[z]; B = -i C gamma^(x4), B^dagger = B, B^2 = 1, signature (8,8); no positive inner product with Psi^dagger the adjoint (Krein space, fundamental symmetry B); positive representation chi = Psi^dagger B, {Psi_A, chi_C} = delta_AC; Heisenberg: d4 Psi = -i B (1/Cos[z]) dHd/dPsi^dagger = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U') Psi - sum_(a != 4) gamma^a D_a Psi]; good sector (no x5, x6, x7 dependence): h Hermitian for Cos[z] d^7x, positive Fock space, normal-ordered H = sum E (b^* b + d^* d) >= 0 per momentum; expectation-value rule <Psi^dagger M Psi> = u^dagger B M u (u^dagger u = 1, positive-energy good-sector u); EMT operator T^mu_nu = :T^mu_nu[Psi, Psi^dagger = chi B]: (normal ordered), <T> by the same rule; extra-time modes: E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2 < 0 for k_t^2 > m^2 + k_s^2, growing as exp(|E| x4)

formulas.description: NON-TRIVIALITY [1] (dirac16complex) and [2] (dirac16complex00): exact content of checks nontriviality_1_dirac16complex, nontriviality_2_dirac16complex00, gammaOmega_x4_terms_cancel, Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_and_H_vanish, never_flat_for_H_positive, spin_curvature_equals_Riemann
formulas.wl: gamma^mu D_mu Psi - gamma^mu d_mu Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi (nonzero for every H > 0, every a4, every Psi != 0); per direction gamma^(xi) Omega_xi = (a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) (i = 1, 2, 3, inflating) and gamma^(xt) Omega_xt = -(a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) (t = 5, 6, 7, deflating): the time-direction terms cancel (3 a4'/2 - 3 a4'/2 = 0), the hidden-direction terms add (6 H/2 = 3 H); Omega_mu = 0 for all mu iff a4' = 0 and H = 0 (H = 0 is a degenerate limit of the metric); [D_mu, D_nu] = (1/2) R_ab,mu,nu S^ab, and R^x8_x8 = -6 H^2 != 0: no frame removes Omega, the metric is never flat for H > 0

formulas.description: the notebook's Majorana-type Lagrangian with real components (checks Majorana_Lg_total_derivative_grassmann, Majorana_Lg_commuting_control)
formulas.wl: anticommuting real Psi: sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu D_mu Psi = d_mu ((1/2) sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu Psi) (a total derivative; no field equation; Psi^T C Psi = 0); commuting real Phi: Euler-Lagrange expression 2 sqrt g C gamma^mu D_mu Phi and Phi^T C gamma^mu Phi = 0

formulas.description: exact solutions used as test points (checks exact_solution_*)
formulas.wl: (i) U = 0: Psi = Sin[z]^al (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi, M = -m g[x4] + 3 H (2 al + 1) g[x4].g[x8], k^2 = 9 H^2 (2 al + 1)^2 - m^2 (any a4); (ii) U = (lam/2) S^2, homogeneous: Psi = (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi, M = -(m + lam S0) g[x4] + 3 H g[x4].g[x8], S0 = chi^dagger C chi, k^2 = 9 H^2 - (m + lam S0)^2 (commuting); Grassmann: Psi = sum_k [exp(M_m x4) + lam S0 d/dm exp(M_m x4)] chi_k theta_k, S0 = sum_kl thetabar_k theta_l chi_k^dagger C chi_l; at (ii): rho = m S0 + lam S0^2/2, p3 = p_t = p8 = lam S0^2/2

formulas.description: pressures and equations of state from the diagonal components (SPEC section 4)
formulas.wl: rho = -T^x4_x4, p3 = T^x1_x1, p_t = T^x5_x5, p8 = T^x8_x8; w3 = p3/rho, w_t = p_t/rho, w8 = p8/rho; homogeneous on shell: w3 = w_t = w8 = (S U' - U)/(m S + U)

formulas.description: role of the spin-connection term in the quantum theory (check good_sector_hermiticity_curved)
formulas.wl: Cos[z] [p (Tan[z] d8 + 3 H) q + ((Tan[z] d8 + 3 H) p) q] = d8 (Sin[z] p q): the operator Tan[z] d8 + 3 H is antisymmetric for the measure Cos[z] dx8 up to the boundary term Sin[z] p q, which does not vanish at z = Pi/2; without 3 H the mode operator is not formally Hermitian for this measure and these variables (Psi = Sin[z]^(-1/2) chi with the measure dy needs no such term)
